name: Economy log: a Bloodforged rare kill's Bazaar Tokens count as tokens earned from kills
contract: Requires Bloodforged.Enable = 1, PvpPower.Enable = 1, Bloodforged.BazaarTokens.RareMob = 300 and CoA.BazaarTokens.HourlyCap.Amount = 1250, like bloodforged-rare-mob-bazaar-tokens.

With the economy log on, the 300 Bazaar Tokens a level 60 High-Risk character gets for killing the rare Foreman Marcrid (1844) are summed into the tokens_earned row with source 1 (kill), so that row holds at least 300.

steps.label: CONTROL: the rare kill gives the 300 Bazaar Tokens
THE LOG: the kill's tokens_earned row holds them
